turns.replyTail:
Agent powered by

Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter: Shipping and tracking timing can vary, especially during busy periods. Once your parcel is scanned by the shipping provider, you’ll receive an email with the tracking number. If your order status is Pending, please allow up to 24–48 hours for tracking to become available. If it shows Information Received, the shipping label has been created and the parcel may still be waiting for its first courier scan; updates can take up to 24 hours.
